title: Circle Shareholder Sues Trump, Alleging Unconstitutional Profits From $2B UAE Crypto Deals
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Circle Shareholder Sues Trump, Alleging Unconstitutional Profits From $2B UAE Crypto Deals A shareholder of stablecoin giant Circle has alleged the president corruptly cashed in on crypto deals. This post Circle Shareholder Sues Trump, Alleging Unconstitutional Profits From $2B UAE Crypto Deals first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
